Class PowerDistribution

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.hardware.power.PowerDistribution
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, TelemetryLoggable
public class PowerDistribution extends Object implements TelemetryLoggable, AutoCloseable
Class for getting voltage, current, temperature, power and energy from the CTRE Power Distribution Panel (PDP) or REV Power Distribution Hub (PDH) over CAN.
